messages:
rachel: Quick sync: CS reported multiple newbies hitting our JS quickstart and getting only `Error: Bad request`. Go and Python show `InvalidArgument` with a useful `hint`. We need a small cross-team fix.
omar: Yikes. That mismatch kills onboarding. What’s the minimal path?
lee: JS SDK currently maps body.message -> Error.message and drops structured fields. We should: (1) parse canonical envelope `{code,human_message,hint,http_status,retry_after}`; (2) throw Error subclasses (e.g., InvalidArgumentError) that carry those props.
toni: Also update the sampleapp README codeblock — it suggests `if (err.type === 'InvalidArgument')` which only applies to Go. Replace with `err instanceof InvalidArgumentError` or `err.code === 'InvalidArgument'`.
rachel: Streaming caveat: sometimes socket closes with just status. Suggest adding header `x-rw-error: 1` and when available include a compact JSON trailer. SDKs should fall back to status->code mapping if no body.
omar: Proposed mapping table for docs (canonical codes): 400 -> InvalidArgument, 401 -> AuthenticationFailed, 403 -> PermissionDenied, 404 -> ResourceNotFound, 409 -> Conflict, 422 -> InvalidState, 429 -> RateLimit, 5xx -> ServerError. Include `retry_after` for 429.
lee: I’ll own JS PR for error classes + compat wrapper that converts legacy message shapes into the envelope for one release. ETA: tomorrow EOD. Adding unit tests.
toni: I’ll update sampleapp + quickstart snippets and add a line in changelog. ETA: Friday.
ci-bot: Created ticket DE-5012 "SDK error parity + onboarding fixes" assigned to lee and toni. https://github.com/redwood/devex/issues/5012
rachel: QA: add an integration check in sampleapp CI that POSTs an oversized prompt and asserts `err.code === 'InvalidArgument' && typeof err.human_message === 'string'`.
lee: Will add test. Also adding a linter rule so constructing RedwoodError without `code` and `human_message` fails.
toni: UX rule: human_message must be concise (<140 chars) and actionable. No raw stacks.
omar: After PRs merge, CS will re-open the impacted tickets for verification.
rachel: Thanks all — small but high-impact. Keep me posted when PRs are green.
